title: Iowa Code Chapter 422 - Individual Income, Corporate, and Franchise Taxes
deposited: Iowa Code ch. 422, whole chapter. Subchapter I: definitions, including "Internal Revenue Code" (422.3). Subchapter II, personal net income tax: the flat 3.8% rate (422.5(1)(a); section 422.5A, "Tax rates", is repealed for tax years from 2025), net income computed from federal taxable income (422.7, including the subtraction of Social Security benefits taxable under IRC s86), the earned income tax credit at 15% of the federal credit (422.12B), and other credits. Subchapters III-X: corporate tax, financial institutions, administration, withholding (422.16) and others. 125 sections.
